videos.title: Super Practical Guide to Color Theory, Color Models and Perfect Color Palettes | UI Design
videos.why: Jump to 7:47 for the HSB model, a close cousin of the HSL sliders in this lesson, then watch the colour categories from 11:47 to see why some saturation and brightness combinations look muddy on screen.

videos.title: How to Not Suck at Color - 5 color theory tips every designer should know
videos.why: Greg Gunn's five colour tips; the harmonies at 0:45 are the schemes you try in lab-harmony, and the section at 2:33 on why using less colour is better is the habit most generated palettes lack.

podcasts.why: A classic episode on how humans and other animals see colour and how languages came to name it; good grounding for the idea that colour is something the eye and brain construct.

reads.title: Color in UI Design: A (Practical) Framework
reads.why: Erik Kennedy's rule for colour variations is that darker versions get more saturated and less bright, and lighter versions the reverse; try it on your own brand colour in lab-color-match.

reads.title: Color Formats in CSS
reads.why: Hex, RGB, HSL and the newer perceptual formats compared with interactive demos; read the HSL section to see why it is the easiest format for picking related colours by hand.
